evidence.why: Contains the conditional restoration helper and complete transition body.

facts.rationale: Preserves the existing data-flow description while making the reflector-restoration guard explicit.
facts.value: Derives Fighter from gobj, passes both to the common ground-to-air transition with ftMt_MS_SpecialAirS and FTMEWTWO_SPECIALS_COLL_FLAG, clamps air drift, configures the aerial grab path, and installs ftMt_SpecialS_ReflectThink in accessory4_cb. The final helper writes reflecting=true, x2218_b4=true, and reflect_hit_cb=ftMt_SpecialS_OnReflect only when mv.mt.SpecialS.isConfusionReflect is already true; otherwise it makes no reflector writes.
